# Shipping Labels (Modul4r)

> Free shipping label generator. Builds a printable sender/receiver address
> label for Canada and US addresses, printed straight from the browser.

The whole tool is one page. Fill in the sender and receiver address, then
print. No signup, no account, nothing sent to a server.

## What it does

- Captures sender and receiver name, street address, city, province or
  state, and postal or ZIP code.
- Supports Canada (13 provinces/territories) and the US (50 states plus DC).
- Renders a FROM/TO address label instantly as you type.
- Prints from the browser's own print dialog. Best results: Letter size,
  100% scale.

## What it does not do

- No carrier or courier integration. The label is a plain address format,
  not a carrier-specific barcode or tracking number. Pair it with a tracking
  label from Canada Post, USPS, UPS, FedEx or any other courier for the
  actual shipment.
- No account, no saved address book, no data sent to a server: everything
  runs in the browser.

## Cost

Free.

- [Open the generator](https://labels.modul4r.com/): the tool itself.
